texts.en:
A number of our [Owner.GetCitizenPlural] have perceived uncanny apparitions at various locations on [Owner.Capital.GetName]. In most cases, these have been chance sightings without repetition, but one site has drawn attention for frequent visitations. [Owner.GetPhantomPresenceExtra]
